title: Canonical IR and CLI
acceptance_criteria: Two runs over the same project produce byte-for-byte equivalent canonical IR after normalization.
Generators can operate solely on IR without reparsing source files.
`aidl check --format json`, `aidl ir`, and `aidl plan` are usable from scripts and coding agents.
